description: This file provides fixture support functions and decorators for test setup and cleanup, including handling of context managers and coroutine functions, specifically for the behave testing framework. It defines how fixtures are registered, used, and cleaned up, with special handling for generator-based fixtures and composite fixtures.

classes.name: InvalidFixtureError
classes.description: Exception raised when a fixture is invalid, such as a generator with more than one yield.

methods.name: _setup_fixture
methods.description: Core function to set up a fixture, handling context manager fixtures and registering cleanup functions.

methods.name: use_fixture
methods.description: Calls a fixture function to perform setup and registers cleanup if applicable.

methods.name: use_fixture_by_tag
methods.description: Processes a fixture tag to retrieve and use the corresponding fixture from a registry.

methods.name: fixture_call_params
methods.description: Creates a tuple of fixture function and its parameters for composite fixtures.

methods.name: use_composite_fixture_with
methods.description: Creates multiple fixtures with cleanup support, ensuring cleanup even if setup fails.

methods.name: fixture
methods.description: Decorator to mark functions as fixtures, optionally with a name and pattern.
